suture.d: an immovable joint (especially between the bones of the skull)

sutra.d: a rule or aphorism in Sanskrit literature or a group of aphoristic doctrinal summaries prepared for memorization

sutler.d: a supplier of victuals or supplies to an army

suttee.d: the act of a Hindu widow willingly cremating herself on the funeral pyre of her dead husband

sutura internasalis.d: the suture between the two nasal bones

sutura sagittalis.d: the suture uniting the two parietal bones
